podcasts.title: Academic Agent — áudio
podcasts.author: Academic Agent
podcasts.description: Episódios do canal Academic Agent em formato de áudio, reunidos em um feed não oficial para escuta em aplicativos de podcast.

episodes.title: The CIA Propaganda Trick That Still Shapes What You Believe | Hugh Wilford
episodes.description: Examine how CIA psychological operations shaped the cultural landscape of the Cold War. We analyse the methods used to influence public sentiment through organised propaganda.

episodes.title: What the CIA Didn't Want You to Know | Frances Stonor Saunders
episodes.description: Examine the Cultural Cold War to understand how the CIA manipulated global intellectual and artistic discourse.

episodes.title: The Myth of Raw Talent: Why Repetition is Everything | Alex Ferguson
episodes.description: Examine the essential leadership qualities that define successful individuals and how character impacts long-term influence.

episodes.title: Why Your Identity Is A Construction | David Bowie
episodes.description: Explore how David Bowie used the artistic persona to redefine rock music and anticipate major cultural shifts.
